tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "contract_price_not_yet_effective", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0258", "detail": "PO line 1 'Black Laser Printer Toner' is priced at IDR 739,700 per unit, not the 842,400 invoiced."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-036#11.1", "detail": "Addendum No. 1 changes the Black Laser Printer Toner unit price to IDR 842,400.00 only from September 28, 2026."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-036#2.2", "detail": "A unit price change takes effect only through a signed written addendum and never retroactively."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "KOS-26-00682", "detail": "Invoice date is 2026-09-21, seven days before the new price took effect, yet line 1 is billed at 842,400 per unit."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0258", "detail": "Receipt of 6 toner units on 2026-09-19 does not carry the later contract price."}], "explanation": "Line 1 uses the contract's increased toner price of IDR 842,400, but clause KTR-V-036#11.1 makes that price effective only from 2026-09-28 and clause #2.2 forbids retroactive application, so the invoice dated 2026-09-21 must still use the PO price of 739,700."}]}
